2607.02043.title: Towards Load-Aware Prefill Deflection for Disaggregated LLM Serving
2607.02043.paper_summary: Disaggregated LLM serving runs prefill and decode on separate GPU pools to keep the two phases from interfering. In practice, this creates a new asymmetry: under bursty, heavy-tailed workloads prefill nodes saturate while decode nodes have compute underutilized, and on a production-style A100 cluster with 2 prefill and 2 decode nodes (2P2D), we find that prefill execution accounts for only 2-23% of P95 Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Queuing and inter-node GPU-GPU KV-cache transfer account for the rest. We present a proactive prefill-deflecting scheduler that lets decode nodes serve prefill phase of requests as chunked-prefill steps interleaved with their in-flight decode batches. For each queued request, we estimate the TTFT it would see on the prefill node, and on every decode node, search for the largest chunk schedule that keeps in-flight decodes within their Time-Between-Tokens (TBT) SLO and deflect when the decode path helps tail latency. Because the prefill phase of deflected requests runs in place on the decode node, the inter-node KV transfer is eliminated. Implemented on vLLM and evaluated on production-style traces with DeepSeek-V2-Lite, our approach reduces P95 TTFT by upto 81% and raises SLO attainment by upto 79% over state-of-the-art disaggregated schedulers, at sub-millisecond per-request routing cost.
2607.02043.paper_summary_zh: 分散式 LLM 服務在不同的 GPU 池上運行預填充和解碼，以避免這兩個階段之間的干擾。實際上，這產生了一種新的不對稱性：在突發的重尾工作負載下，預填充節點飽和，而解碼節點則計算資源未被充分利用，在一個具有 2 個預填充和 2 個解碼節點的生產風格 A100 集群（2P2D）上，我們發現預填充執行僅佔 P95 首個標記時間（TTFT）的 2-23%。排隊和節點間 GPU-GPU KV 緩存轉移佔據了其餘部分。我們提出了一種主動的預填充轉向調度器，讓解碼節點能夠在其正在進行的解碼批次中交錯處理請求的預填充階段。對於每個排隊的請求，我們估算它在預填充節點上會看到的 TTFT，並在每個解碼節點上尋找最大的塊調度，以保持正在進行的解碼在其標準服務水平協議（SLO）內的標記間隔時間（TBT），並在解碼路徑有助於尾延遲時進行轉向。由於被轉向的請求的預填充階段在解碼節點上就地運行，因此節點間的 KV 轉移被消除。在 vLLM 上實現並在使用 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 的生產風格跟踪中評估，我們的方法將 P95 TTFT 降低了高達 81%，並將 SLO 達成率提高了高達 79%，每個請求的路由成本低於毫秒級。
